logline: Every time Messi collects another Ballon d'Or, Ronaldo has a new excuse — until his own 'the numbers don't deceive' board flips to Messi 8, CR7 5, so he gives himself a trophy.

over Ronaldo's shoulder: angry phone post '…lie in this way'
Ronaldo at the mic: 'losing credibility' — the golden ball deflates
Ronaldo rolls in a giant 54 GOALS board: 'the numbers don't deceive'; Messi flips it: 8-5
Ronaldo makes his own trophy and crowns himself, SIUUU
Messi looks into the camera and slurps his mate

twist: his own 'numbers don't deceive' board shows Messi 8 Ronaldo 5
